provider: NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies / GFWED
api_version: v2.0 dataset path segment, HTTP file archive (not an API protocol version)

request_contract.parameter_rules: This is an exact provider-published example file path and evidence of a potential NetCDF acquisition route, NOT an executable OpenCatastrophe download operation. No HTTP HEAD/GET/Range, crawler, recursive archive walk, redirects, user supplied URL/path/date, credential use or storage of source bytes is allowed by this contract. Later independent authorization must pin the exact version, file date, expected response size, byte caps, terms and SHA-256 evidence.

response_contract.format: Provider NetCDF archive path is documented, but response content type, magic bytes, compression, variables, dimensions and checksum have not been observed. This profile authorizes no response acquisition.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: NASA GFWED computes Canadian Fire Weather Index family from reanalysis/weather model forcing including precipitation variants. The described GEOS-5 subset uses experimental near-real-time analysis, not a raw sensor fire-detection record. Retain FWI index meaning, local-noon sampling convention, model/forcing lineage, daily time, grid, missing values and version identity; fire-weather danger must not be equated to fire occurrence, footprint or insured loss.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No automated HTTP probe is authorized until exact third-party rights, source persistence and provider usage policy have been reviewed. The provider's example wget/curl snippet describes generic retrieval ability only.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Provider portal documents a v2.0 path and multiple precipitation/calculation variants. Do not infer that an HTTP file name freezes all upstream science, nor accept missing/cached/redirected data as a successful source receipt. Exact file SHA-256, date, response provenance and byte size are still unknown.

rights_and_policy.notes: NASA GISS publicly documents the GFWED NetCDF downloads, but no exact product/file licence, API automation terms, commercial insurer-use or derivative redistribution permission has been reviewed in this PR. NASA branding or government-source generalizations are not a substitute for a product-specific rights decision, including input precipitation and model lineage. Do not execute data acquisition or publish bytes until source-specific terms are established.

notes: T0 documented_only access contract. Explicitly nonexecutable. First future bounded step, after legal review, would be a single exact-file HEAD or range-limited NetCDF signature/header check with immutable URI/date, checksum and response receipt and no bulk downloads; scientific crosswalk with FIRMS would preserve non-independence of forcing and fire detections. No actual external file bytes or Neon records are present.
